# World: the Tier R gate record 17 FM-10.2 writes by hand (KS-0.1 refuses to start without it).

column3: test -s "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/$TIER_R_RECORD" || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/$TIER_R_RECORD")" && printf '# Tier R gate record (setup 17 FM-10.2)\nTest stand-in for the record the platform owner and the second human sign.\n' > "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR/$TIER_R_RECORD"; }

column1: # KS-2.10: the accepted spelling KS-2.5 recorded, committed into floors.json and merged; the floor record and FLOOR_RECORD.

column3: cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && f="$(ls "$BUILD_LOG_DIR"/records/*-KS-2.5-platform-floor-v1.txt | tail -n 1)" && s="$(sed -n '1s/^accepted spelling: //p' "$f")" && test -n "$s" && jq --arg s "$s" '.spellings.accepted = $s' model-armor/floors.json > model-armor/floors.json.new && mv model-armor/floors.json.new model-armor/floors.json && git add model-armor/floors.json && git commit -qm "model-armor: record the accepted gcloud enum spelling (setup 18 KS-2.10; test stand-in: merged)" && git push -q origin HEAD:main && REC="records/$DATE-KS-2.10-floor-record-v1.md" && printf '# Floor record (setup 18)\nTest stand-in for the record the platform owner writes at KS-2.10. Accepted write form: %s (KS-2.5). Comparison spelling: rest, always.\n' "$s" > "$BUILD_LOG_DIR/$REC" && penv_set --force FLOOR_RECORD "$REC"

column1: # KS-4.1: the k7/ files as the merged pull request leaves them (eight KF-1 files without aiplatform and run, the KF-2
# template and permissions list, scheduler-pause.txt, pab-empty.json, README.md, the /k7/ CODEOWNERS line), then K7_POLICY_DIR.

column3:
cd "$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR" && K=k7 && mkdir -p "$K/restrict-service-usage" && for PAIR in "fld-agents-r-prod:$FLD_AGENTS_R_PROD" "fld-agents-r-nonprod:$FLD_AGENTS_R_NONPROD" "fld-agents-w-prod:$FLD_AGENTS_W_PROD" "fld-agents-w-nonprod:$FLD_AGENTS_W_NONPROD" "fld-agents-p-prod:$FLD_AGENTS_P_PROD" "fld-agents-p-nonprod:$FLD_AGENTS_P_NONPROD" "fld-agents-p-sa-prod:$FLD_AGENTS_P_SA_PROD" "fld-agents-p-sa-nonprod:$FLD_AGENTS_P_SA_NONPROD"; do N="${PAIR%%:*}"; ID="${PAIR##*:}"; jq -n --arg id "$ID" '{name: ("folders/" + $id + "/policies/gcp.restrictServiceUsage"), spec: {rules: [{values: {allowedValues: ["logging.googleapis.com", "modelarmor.googleapis.com", "monitoring.googleapis.com"]}}]}}' > "$K/restrict-service-usage/$N.json"; done && printf '%s
' "# KF-3: pause every cloudscheduler.googleapis.com/Job and detach every push subscription under the selected folders (test stand-in)." > "$K/scheduler-pause.txt" && echo '[]' > "$K/pab-empty.json" && KF2_PERMS='["aiplatform.googleapis.com/reasoningEngines.query", "aiplatform.googleapis.com/reasoningEngines.create", "aiplatform.googleapis.com/reasoningEngines.update", "aiplatform.googleapis.com/reasoningEngines.delete", "aiplatform.googleapis.com/reasoningEngines.list", "aiplatform.googleapis.com/reasoningEngines.get", "run.googleapis.com/routes.invoke", "run.googleapis.com/jobs.run", "run.googleapis.com/jobs.runWithOverrides", "pubsub.googleapis.com/topics.publish"]' && echo "$KF2_PERMS" | jq -r '.[]' > "$K/deny-agents-halt.permissions.txt" && jq -n --argjson perms "$KF2_PERMS" '{displayName: "deny-agents-halt (K7 KF-2)", rules: [{description: "KF-2 halt: selected tier folders only; no exception principals", denyRule: {deniedPrincipals: ["@AGENT_AND_SA_PRINCIPALS@"], deniedPermissions: $perms}}]}' > "$K/deny-agents-halt.template.json" && printf '# K7 fleet kill switch: lever files (setup 18 KS-4.1; design 04 section 9)
Test stand-in for the README the page writes.
' > "$K/README.md" && mkdir -p .github && printf '/k7/ @second-human-test
' >> .github/CODEOWNERS && git add k7 .github/CODEOWNERS && git commit -qm "k7: lever files generated from live allow-lists (setup 18 KS-4.1; test stand-in: merged)" && git push -q origin HEAD:main && penv_set --force K7_POLICY_DIR k7
